profile: Rust 1.98.0 x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, -Cpanic=abort --cap-lints=allow, RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1 where declared, per-case editions; declared 2026-11-07 before any rustc or RustGM run of these files
oracle_result: all fifteen declared rustc outcomes held, including codes E0659, E0603, E0252 and E0658, the native line/column/cfg values 7 9 1 and the facade client's exit 0; round 2 reran all fifteen after the amended bridge fixture and they held

cases.name: exporter
cases.note: no_core source-core provider: root builtin and declarative rows, a builtin defined in a private module and reachable only through re-exports, root and renamed re-exports, and a core-shaped prelude of explicit re-exports and a glob; publishes re-export rows in tag-14 version 2

cases.name: exporter-path-client
cases.note: path and use forms through prelude, root and renamed re-exports reach their definitions; the consumer's own line/column/cfg expanders run at the call site

cases.name: exporter-glob-client
cases.note: two globs bind concat and file to one identity each, so neither is ambiguous

cases.name: exporter-ambiguous-client
cases.note: two globs bind file to two definitions with one expander: identity, not the expander or name, decides ambiguity

cases.name: exporter-macro-use-client
cases.note: #[macro_use] brings every root macro binding, root re-exports included

cases.name: exporter-macro-use-placed-client
cases.note: concat is bound only in builtin and the prelude modules, never at the root

cases.name: exporter-private-client
cases.note: the hidden definition's own module is private; its rows bind only at public re-export placements. Amended after candidate round 1: the declared diagnostic was `unresolved macro`, but RustGM rejects with the module's privacy, as rustc's E0603 does

cases.name: exporter-alias-client
cases.note: a renamed extern crate and a local module named prelude: re-export rows bind by the provider's module identity, never by name or alias

cases.name: exporter-duplicate-client
cases.note: two explicit imports of one name collide even when both name one identity

cases.name: bridge
cases.note: source client that re-exports another crate's definition rows and re-exports; publishes only re-export rows, which needs tag-14 version 2. Amended after candidate round 1: `pub use exporter::forty_two` in a nested module failed in RustGM with `unresolved import`, an extern-prelude gap of no_core source clients that a function re-export shares; the nested re-export now names the root `extern crate` item, and the rustc oracle was rerun

cases.name: bridge-client
cases.note: reaches exporter's rows through bridge's re-export rows; exporter is inventory only, bound by crate identity without an alias

cases.name: aliased-provider
cases.frontend_diagnostic: macro bindings in a module reached only through a re-export are outside the macro metadata profile
cases.note: requirement: a module reached only through a public alias has no public placement, so its macro binding is rejected by name rather than dropped

cases.name: facade
cases.note: ordinary crate re-exporting an upstream declarative row, a renamed one and a re-export of its own re-export

cases.name: facade-client
cases.note: the upstream row's allowance list follows its identity through both re-exports

cases.name: facade-unchecked-client
cases.frontend_diagnostic: cfg(ub_checks) requires cfg_ub_checks or its actual macro allowance
cases.note: the renamed re-export names the row without an allowance list, so cfg(ub_checks) stays gated
